The test image shows soybean leaves with numerous small scattered spots — yellowish/tan with some reddish tints, distributed across many leaves. Key candidates: Septoria_brown_spot, Cercospora, Frogeye_leaf_spot, Bacterial_Blight.

Now I'll view one reference per candidate class.

**Analysis:**

- **Test image**: Soybean canopy-wide, many leaves showing numerous small scattered spots with yellowish/tan/reddish coloration. Spots are small, irregular to slightly circular, spread throughout the canopy.

- **Septoria_brown_spot** (ref): Small dark spots on heavily yellowing leaves — more leaf yellowing than in test image.

- **Cercospora** (ref): That reference showed seed staining, not matching.

- **Frogeye_leaf_spot** (ref): Small scattered spots distributed across green leaves throughout the canopy — pattern very similar to test image, with reddish-bordered spots.

- **Bacterial_Blight** (ref): Angular yellowish spots with darker centers — somewhat similar but lesions more angular/large than test image.

The canopy-wide distribution of numerous small discrete spots most closely matches **Frogeye_leaf_spot**, which shows scattered small circular lesions with reddish borders on otherwise green leaves.
